newsitem.title: USA: Thermo Sentron gets Latin American orders.
newsitem.headline: Thermo Sentron gets Latin American orders.

text.p: Thermo Sentron Inc said Thursday it received orders totaling more than $800,000 from customers in the Latin American food industry.
Thermo Sentron said its systems will be used to check the quantity of food being packaged, while its metal detectors will be used to inspect packages for metal fragments.

"These orders reflect a growing market for our products in Latin America, where there is increasing consumer and regulatory demand for higher-quality packaged goods," Lewis J. Ribich, president, said in a statement.
Most of the orders were placed by customers in the food-processing industry in Brazil, where new consumer-protection legislation recently went into effect.
Thermo Sentron is a public subsidiary of Thermedics Inc.
